title: Murder Going Down
summary: A woman is found stabbed in an elevator. The team struggles to figure out how the murder was committed in the 15 seconds it took the elevator to go down one floor.
method: The victim actually went down one more floor to the pool area, where they were stabbed. When the body was found, they were going up the elevator. The call the housekeeper witnessed was not a real call, and the actual call to reception happened later, distorting the time of death. A piece of the victim's nail was found in the pool drain.
motive: The victim was dying of an illness and was about to reveal that her daughter was not theirs and that they coerced a criminal into giving up their baby.
killer: The victim's husband and son in law.
notes:
The daughter was discovered not to be biologically theirs because she has brown eyes and both the parents have blue eyes.
Dwayne returns
